best_policy.name: recency-frequency-deep-scaled-with-aging
best_policy.retention_score: last_access + 4.0 * log1p(frequency) * log1p(depth + 1) + 0.5 * min(now - inserted_at, 10000) * (1 if frequency > 0 else 0.3) + 2.0 * log1p(insertion_order)

usage.cost_basis: Configured uncached rates for the selected transport; pending/unknown results retain reservation
